title: MulmoTerminal — a cell can be a plain shell, not just an agent
description: Short feature clip. The launcher's Shell toggle starts your OS shell as a persistent terminal in the grid — a dev server's request log runs beside the agents. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: A cell can be a plain shell, not just an agent. Start a dev server, and its log runs in the grid.
